chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Were it not that Allah, the Exalted, created Fatimah for Ali, there would have been no equal for her on the face of the earth, from Adam and those below him.

key_terms.آدَمُ: Adam عليه السلام, mentioned as the starting point of comparison
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the Exalted Lord who ordained this creation and pairing
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Sayyidah Fatimah عليها السلام, whose unique rank is being described
key_terms.كُفْوٌ: An equal, match, or counterpart in compatibility and rank
key_terms.لِعَلِيٍّ: For Ali عليه السلام; indicating divinely designated compatibility

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about Fatimah عليها السلام having no equal on earth mean?
ai.summary: This hadith expresses the unique spiritual rank and incomparable status of Sayyidah Fatimah عليها السلام and her divinely ordained compatibility with Imam Ali عليه السلام. It emphasizes that no one on earth, beginning from Adam عليه السلام onward, was her equal apart from the one for whom Allah created her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Had Allah (swt), the Exalted, not created Sayyida Fatimah {s.a} for Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), there would not have been any equal for her on the face of the earth, from Adam to those after him."
